pending_interview.question: You are leading an AI engineering team that is midway through a high-visibility project. Midway through, you receive strong signals — from your own engineers, not from leadership — that the project's core technical assumption is flawed and the timeline is not recoverable without a significant scope change. Leadership has publicly committed to the original timeline. Walk me through exactly how you would handle this situation, from the moment you confirm the problem to the moment a decision is made.
